simple.summary: שָׁכָה (shâkâh) means to roam (through lust) First listed occurrence: Jer 5 8.

definitions.full: H7904. shakah [ שָׁכָה , so most] verb Hiph`il Participle as adjective in הָיוּ מַשְׁכִּים מוּזָנִים סוּסִים Jer 5:8 usually, horses... roaming at large they have become (compare Ethiopic ); — but meaning lustful needed; Aq Theod ἔλκοντες , Jerome trahentes (that is, genitalia ), i.e. משְׁכִים ; read with Arnheim Du Dr מַאֲשָׁכִים , i.e. fed stallions (literally growing אֲשָׁכִים , Lev 21:20 ; compare מַפְרִים מַקְרִין, ).
